title: Neutral Phantoms
description: Makes phantoms attack only if provoked.
body:
## About
Whether you were deep in a mine, caught up building, or simply forgot, skipping a night or two (or **three** for that matter) happens to the best of us. Next thing you know, something's swooping at you from above. A little harsh for just losing track of time.

**Neutral Phantoms** is a small quality of life datapack that makes phantoms **passive by default**. Should you ever find yourself in such a situation, they'll leave you alone until you give them a reason not to — **hit one**, and it turns **hostile**.
Perhaps the skies don't have to be so unforgiving after all ? But don't get too comfortable. Karma has a way of finding you...

**THIS PROJECT IS MULTIPLAYER COMPATIBLE :D**

## (SPOILER) Phantom's Curse
Killing a phantom — which would now have to be deliberate — places the _**Phantom's Curse**_ on the player, preventing sleep for **three consecutive nights**. Sound familiar?

*Made using [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com)*
